season.evidence: Web search: Green Creek circuit sources say mid/late June to late July is snow-free on the rock, best in early summer; an early-August Mountaineers report called conditions challenging; stored window Jul-Sep kept, with Aug 20 comfortably inside.

track.why: Single stored route on the peak. The August 20 track leaves the Elbow Lake trailhead, climbs the Green Creek cirque, reaches the saddle and then the west-side summit (50 m from our pin), and returns the same way; start 243 m and end 54 m from our trailhead pin. No logged route name and no report, so identity rests on the one-route exception.

notes: The track has no trip report text and no elevations; the 243 m start offset is just inside 300 m. Confidence medium: the track swings near the Little Sister saddle on its way, so the owner may wish to check it does not claim a neighbouring peak.
